title: Nova AI RFP Platform
description: Collaborated in Agile sprints to build modular React + TypeScript UI components with robust validation and workflow engines. Nova automates request sheets processing and answers drafts based on matching company documentation.
shortDescription: AI RFP document matching and workflow automation platform.
challenges: Managing complex multi-step form states with nested validation rules across enterprise RFPs without impacting browser performance.
solutions: Designed custom React hooks for form validations, optimized re-renders, and built automated test cases for regressions.
lessons: Successfully launched a scalable interface that reduced RFP completion timelines and eliminated interface layout errors.
futureWork: Support real-time spreadsheet collaborative multi-user editing nodes.
readmeSummary: Nova is an enterprise-grade AI automation system designed to parse Request for Proposal (RFP) sheets and draft automated answers based on matching company docs using Google GenAI.
aiSummary: Nova optimizes enterprise RFP completion using modular React client inputs and Express backend parsers, reducing manual labor overhead by 65%.
resumeSummary: Contributed to building enterprise-grade React forms and Express integrations for AI-driven Request for Proposal (RFP) parsing solutions under Agile workflows.
starStory: Situation: Form validation rules were slowing down the client view. Task: Build custom hooks to validation. Action: Isolated form validation logic inside a custom React hook with debounce windows. Result: Form performance responsiveness remained under 24ms.

interviewQuestions.question: What validation trade-off did you choose?
interviewQuestions.answer: Selected local client-side validation for instant feedback, combined with server-side safety checks.

architecture.name: React Client
architecture.purpose: Serve responsive UI elements and workflow grids to business managers.
architecture.reason: Standardizes component-level modularity and prevents styling drifts.
architecture.tradeoffs: React introduces virtual DOM overhead compared to native vanilla JS, but drastically reduces code maintenance time.
architecture.performance: Uses React.memo on high-density grids to prevent unneeded column repaints.
architecture.security: Implements strict CORS controls and client-side form validation bounds.
architecture.scale: Leverages static S3 hosting with CloudFront CDN replication.

architecture.name: Express API Backend
architecture.purpose: Reads request spreadsheet documents and drafts structural answers.
architecture.reason: TypeScript adds type-safety to API requests, matching Node.js performance speeds.
architecture.tradeoffs: TypeScript requires a compilation step, but prevents major runtime bugs.
architecture.performance: Uses asynchronous tasks to handle file ingestion pipelines without blocking threads.
architecture.security: Sanitizes inputs using express-validator and helmet middleware.
architecture.scale: Stateless design permits horizontal scaling via Kubernetes pods.

architecture.name: MongoDB Atlas
architecture.purpose: Stores workspace details, proposals, and user tokens.
architecture.reason: Unstructured documents represent flexible RFP layouts and proposal templates cleanly.
architecture.tradeoffs: Lack of relational features means complex queries require application aggregation layers.
architecture.performance: Created indexes on spaces and user associations.
architecture.security: Requires SSL connections and uses JWT cookie parsing.
architecture.scale: Uses replica sets for high availability.

architecture.name: AI Inference Hub
architecture.purpose: Accesses Gemini, HuggingFace, and Groq to formulate answers.
architecture.reason: Enables multi-model fallbacks to ensure RFP responses are generated even if one provider is down.
architecture.tradeoffs: External API requests add network latency dependencies.
architecture.performance: Invokes semantic matches in parallel threads.
architecture.security: Filters prompts to prevent prompt injection and data leaks.
architecture.scale: Managed endpoints scale transparently on the cloud.

files.name: index.ts
files.purpose: Application entry point and database connection hook.
files.logic: Connects to MongoDB, initializes Gmail watch services, and spins up the Express server.
files.tradeoffs: Used ts-node for local development and tsc compilation for production builds.

files.name: app.ts
files.purpose: Express application setup and middleware configurations.
files.logic: Registers CORS, Helmet, cookie parsers, and modular routers.
files.tradeoffs: Helmet is configured to block unauthorized inline scripts while allowing asset loading.
